notes.title: Update 0.4.4 released - Minor changes
notes.content:
Hello,

This week, we release a minor update that adjusts several graphic settings. A loading screen also appears. 

[h1][b]Added[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b][Menu][/b] A transition screen is added when loading between two scenes;
[*][b][Menu][/b] Footprints are placed in the center of the platform in the main menu to help the placement along;[/list]
[h1][b]Changed[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b][Graphics][/b] Minor fixes.[/list]
We thank you for your patient. See you soon on the rankings!

- RealityZ team

[h1][b]Added[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Update 0.4.1 released - Minor changes
notes.content:
Hello and Happy New Year!

Thank you for the fact that more and more of you are playing at [i]Beat Blocks VR[/i]! In this new year, while we are preparing other surprises for you, we are releasing a minor update.

[h1][b]Fixed[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Minor audio fixes ;
[*]The hand animation could stop working if you pulled multiple triggers at the same time.[/list]

- RealityZ team

tags.bug: The hand animation could stop working if you pulled multiple triggers at the same time.

notes.title: Update 0.4.0 released - Level 5 and balancing
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33844863/c27bad534b3dc4bfea9bb24ab4da38f1a952e04a.jpg[/img]

Hello,

This week, we present you the 5th and last level of this early access! New environment, new music, new grid and new block!

For balancing purposes, we have reorganized the distribution of grids and blocks between levels. Your landmarks may be a little upset, but don't panic, it'll be fine!

[h1][b]Added[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Level 5[/b] - You can unlock it by scoring 4000 on level 4.[/list]
h1][b]Modified[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The content of the levels has been distributed differently between the current levels (the grid and special blocks from the old level 2 are now associated with level 5; the grid and special block from the old level 4 are now associated with level 2; the new grid and special block are associated with level 4.
[*]A button replaces the old instruction on the epilepsy risk warning screen[/list].
[h1][b]Fixed[/b][/h1]
[list]
Minor noise corrections.[/list]

Thank you for being more and more present on the leaderboard. We look forward to following its evolution on all five levels!

- RealityZ team

tags.feature: [b]Level 5[/b] - You can unlock it by scoring 4000 on level 4.

tags.balance_change: For balancing purposes, we have reorganized the distribution of grids and blocks between levels. Your landmarks may be a little upset, but don't panic, it'll be fine!

notes.title: Get into the Leaderboards!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33844863/da6855e5d847314ac25bec7bb3e62f8f9e271047.jpg[/img]

As you can see, the [b]Leadboards[/b] have appeared in Beat Blocks since the last update (0.3.0)! This is your chance to show the best of yourself... or not!

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 released
notes.content:
Hello !

As we are still working on the leaderboard feature, that should be ready very soon, this weekly update is minor.

[h1][b]Changed[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]During calibration, grid is now lower;
[*]In Level 2, the cubes placed are lighter.[/list]
[h1][b]Fixed[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Blocks teleporting outside of the game zone when placed at the same time of a slab's disappearance;
[*]Score could be doubled when a cube was placed at the same time of a slab's disappearance.[/list]

As always, feel free to give us your feedbacks, whether is it a bug or a suggestion!

- RealityZ team

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 released
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33844863/ebc4f609ffe3332e9d8213064469cb2e2be07924.jpg[/img]

Hello,

The first major update is live! More blocks, more beats !

[h1][b]Added[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Level 3[/b] - You can unlock it by scoring 1500 or more in Level 2;
[*][b]Game Over screen[/b] - When you lose, you can now see your score before going back to the menu. You can also restart the level without going back to the menu.[/list]
[h1][b]Changed[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]When they fall from above, the blocks now have a different color: standard blocks are blue and special blocks are purple (red and dark blue for chiral).[/list]
[h1][b]Fixed[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Blocks could be offset when the player grabbed them again;
[*]Player could grab the ghost of a block that was just placed.[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy this update! Feel free to give us your feedbacks.

- RealityZ team
